theme_and_archetype.rationale: Creators need clarity and authority. Moving away from generic 'pastel creator tools' or 'dark mode AI slop', we use a stark, editorial Swiss aesthetic to position this as a high-end 'Growth Agency in your browser'.
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Premium, editorial, smart, objective, function-first, energetic.

rules: No gradients. 100% of UI is stark solid colors.
Accent colors (#FF3B00 - Signal Red and #0033FF - Klein Blue) are used strictly for function: primary actions, active states, or highlighting critical insights.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Blacks are slightly warm (#0A0A0A) to match the off-white paper-like background (#F4F4F0).

bento_grid.rules: Avoid perfect symmetry. In dashboards, mix 1x1 summary squares with 2x2 deep-dive charts.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all data, tables, and paragraphs.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), 2px solid border (border-black). No soft shadows. On hover: hard solid shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]) and -translate-y-1 transition.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background with a hard 2px black bottom border. No glassmorphism.
surface_strategies.agent_terminal: Retro-Futurism style specifically for the multi-agent execution view. Deep black background (#0A0A0A), mono font, neon blue (#0033FF) or white text for log outputs.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B00] text-white rounded-none font-bold tracking-wide uppercase px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#CC2F00] transition-colors border-2 border-[#FF3B00]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#0A0A0A] border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] rounded-none font-bold tracking-wide uppercase px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-white transition-colors

component_customization.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn components with rounded-none. 2px solid black border. Focus ring: 2px solid #0033FF (Klein Blue).
component_customization.tables: Dense, clean. Bottom borders only (border-b-2 border-black/10) for rows. Bold table headers.
component_customization.charts: Recharts. Remove all grid lines. Use thick lines (strokeWidth={3}) or solid bars. Colors: Solid Black, Signal Red, and Klein Blue. Use custom Tooltip with hard black borders.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Hard crisp transitions, no soft easing. Use hover:translate-x-1 or hover:-translate-y-1 with solid drop shadows.
motion_and_interaction.agent_workflow: Sequential text typing effect for agent logs. Staggered fade-ins for chart widgets using framer-motion.

iconography.styling: Stroke width 2. No fill. Sharp, scalable. Keep them monochrome.

hero_image.description: Creator at a desk setup, used in the hero landing section. Apply grayscale or high contrast overlay to fit the Brutalist theme.

editorial_texture.description: Editorial magazine layout used for background texture in the Growth Report cover or empty states.

platform_logos_reference.description: Collage of social media apps. Can be used in the 'Connect Platforms' hero or empty state.

key_views.landing_page: Massive H1. Asymmetric grid layout. A large 'Start Analysis' CTA. A marquee banner showcasing platforms moving slowly.
key_views.dashboard_home: Bento grid of connected platforms. Clean cards. A massive 'Upload CSV/PDF' drag-and-drop zone acting as the primary action area.
key_views.agent_execution: A terminal-like console window overlay. As the multi-agent system runs (Audience Analyst -> Content Strategist -> Engagement Coach -> Competitor Insight -> Action Planner), print out monospace logs dynamically to build trust and show the 'AI thinking'.
key_views.growth_report: Progressive disclosure layout. Start with ONE massive North Star metric. Below it, a clean Recharts graph. Use Tabs to switch between Platforms.
key_views.action_plan: A 'To-Do' list aesthetic. Weekly/Monthly tasks with checkboxes. High-contrast labels (e.g., [URGENT], [CONTENT IDEA]) in mono font.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css.
Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette (background.primary as main bg, etc.).
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the landing page layout, strictly applying the Bento Grid.
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboard components, but override rounded corners to 'rounded-none' and add 'border-2 border-[#0A0A0A]'.
Implement the Multi-Agent Execution View using a mock terminal that loops through agent states (Analyst, Strategist, etc.) and prints monospace logs to simulate processing.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-csv-button').
Use Recharts for Growth Report charts. Remove CartisianGrid or make it invisible. Use strokeWidth={3} for lines.
Do NOT use gradients. Stick to solid colors.
All cards must have a 2px solid black border and hard shadow on hover (e.g., hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0A0A0A]).
